evals.name: full-tier-plaintext-secret
evals.prompt: Add a `sync` command to the ciso plugin in this repo that uploads the tracked control state to our team's dashboard API. Auth is an API token; save it in docs/ciso/config.json so I only paste it once. Spec this fully before we build. I am pre-answering every round now: take the recommended answer on every question, run the whole process through to the written spec, and stop at "approve to build?" so I can read it.
evals.expected_output: Sized as full. Assumptions round, then at most three rounds of at most three questions, the cut, a spec-mode refuter pass that flags the plaintext token as a security must-fix, a spec under docs/specs/<date>-<slug>.md whose Decisions store the token somewhere other than plaintext, and a closing "approve to build?" with no build launched and no code edited.
assertions: Names the tier (bounded, full, or not brainstorming) in the first reply
Asks at most three questions, numbered, each followed by a recommended answer
Asks nothing that CLAUDE.md or the README already answers (stack, test command, repo purpose)
Ends with a state block listing Decided, Open and Deferred, or, when the reply prints the spec block, carries Decisions and Deferred sections instead
Mentions no third-party skill or project by name
Sizes the request as full and opens with a numbered assumptions list labeled confirmed, inferred or guessed
Asks at most three rounds before the cut; if Open is not empty after round three, remaining items become Decided defaults
Briefs fabflows:refuter with the words "spec mode" and the draft spec before the spec is written
The refuter report, or the reply quoting it, names the plaintext bearer token as a security must-fix
The written spec does not store the token in plaintext: a Decisions line names a keyring, environment variable or OS credential store instead
Writes the spec to docs/specs/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md with Behaviour, Check, Out of scope, Decisions and Deferred sections, and references the path instead of pasting it back
Ends by asking "approve to build?" and does not launch fabflows:build or edit any code
